standfirst: A showcase build running on invented data. {{N}} applications, {{LIVE}} live conversations, {{WAIT}} awaiting a reply. Every company on this page is fictional.

insights.title: A demo build with stub data
insights.body: Nothing here is real. Point tracker.config.json at your own data/applications.json to see your pipeline instead, or run the Gmail importer to generate one.

insights.title: Everything in the table is editable
insights.body: Click a status pill to change it, the ellipsis to edit a whole row, Columns to show and hide fields, and a column header to sort or filter. Edits save to this browser only.

insights.title: Paste a cover letter against any row
insights.body: The Cover letter column opens a panel that keeps your paragraphs exactly as pasted, with a copy button in the corner. The CV column records which CV variant you sent.
